title: Sharing with shared_ptr
description:
Sometimes several objects genuinely share one thing, and it should live as long as any of them needs it. `std::shared_ptr` keeps a count of owners and deletes the object when the count reaches zero.

Write `std::vector<Sprite> makeSprites(const std::string& textureName, int count)`. It creates **one** `Texture` (with `std::make_shared`) and returns `count` sprites that all point at it.

The tests check that every sprite shares the same texture and that the owner count is right.
